whatMake: What do you want to make?
usageTooltip: Choose a generation source, add a prompt or reference image, create the asset, then download the ZIP or choose a folder.
shapeDescription: Describe the result. ContentForge handles the technical conversion.
characterPlaceholder: A small ice warrior with a chipped silver helmet
genericPlaceholder: A game-ready asset with a clear silhouette
referenceReady: Ready to use as visual direction
fileHelp: PNG, JPEG, or WebP up to 10 MB
manualNeedsImage: Add a source image to use No-AI mode.
normalizing: Normalizing the image for your game profile
emptyPreviewHelp: Add an idea or reference image, then create one game-ready result.
previewReflects: Preview reflects the selected game adapter
settingsDescription: Provider and project details stay on this machine.
chatgptOAuthWarning: Uses the same Codex OAuth flow as 9Router. This is not the public Images API and may change; image generation requires a Plus/Pro account.
savedKeyPlaceholder: Saved securely. Enter a new key to replace it.
keyPrivacy: The saved key is never sent back to this screen.
openaiAuthHelp: Use an official OpenAI API key or Bearer access token. ChatGPT sign-in is not used directly here.
nineRouterKeyPlaceholder: Optional when authentication is disabled in 9Router
nineRouterHelp: Provider OAuth is managed in the 9Router dashboard; ContentForge only connects to your local or cloud API.
modelPlaceholder: Choose a suggestion or enter a model ID
customModelHelp: You can enter a custom model ID; errors are reported only if the provider rejects it.
automaticExportFolder: The default server folder is selected automatically for the operating system.
folderApiUnavailable: This browser cannot select folders; ContentForge will download the ZIP instead.
loadModelsError: The model list could not be loaded.
createError: The asset could not be created.
exportError: The asset could not be exported.
